/**
 * cn: clsx-joined class fragments with tailwind-merge conflict resolution (the last class of a group wins, and a
 * class removes the earlier classes of the groups it overrides: p-2 removes px-4, not the reverse). Port of cn_merge.go.
 */
final class CnMerge
{
    public static function merge(array $classes): string
    {
        $tokens = [];
        foreach ($classes as $chunk) {
            foreach (preg_split('/\s+/', trim((string) $chunk)) ?: [] as $t) {
                if ($t !== '') {
                    $tokens[] = $t;
                }
            }
        }
        $kept = [];
        foreach ($tokens as $token) {
            [$prefix, $key, $removes] = self::classKey($token);
            if ($key !== '') {
                $drop = [$key => true];
                foreach ($removes as $g) {
                    $drop[$prefix . $g] = true;
                }
                $kept = array_values(array_filter($kept, fn ($it) => !isset($drop[$it[1]])));
            }
            $kept[] = [$token, $key];
        }
        return implode(' ', array_map(fn ($it) => $it[0], $kept));
    }

    private static function classKey(string $token): array
    {
        [$prefix, $core] = self::splitVariant($token);
        if ($core === '') {
            return ['', '', []];

        $groups = self::utilityGroups($core);
        if (!$groups) {
            return [$prefix, '=' . $token, []];
        }
        return [$prefix, $prefix . $groups[0], array_slice($groups, 1)];
    }

    private static function splitVariant(string $token): array
    {
        $depth = 0;
        $cut = -1;
        $n = strlen($token);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $c = $token[$i];

                $depth++;

                    $depth--;
                }
            } elseif ($c === ':' && $depth === 0) {
                $cut = $i;
            }

            return ['', self::noBang($token)];
        }
        return [substr($token, 0, $cut + 1), self::noBang(substr($token, $cut + 1))];
    }

    private static function noBang(string $s): string
    {
        return str_starts_with($s, '!') ? substr($s, 1) : $s;
    }

    private static function utilityGroups(string $core): array

        switch ($core) {
            case 'block': case 'inline': case 'inline-block': case 'inline-flex': case 'flex': case 'grid': case 'contents': case 'hidden':
                return ['display'];

            ['max-w-', 'max-width'], ['max-h-', 'max-height'], ['shadow-', 'shadow'], ['ring-', 'ring'], ['rounded-', 'rounded'],
            ['leading-', 'leading'], ['tracking-', 'tracking'], ['opacity-', 'opacity'], ['z-', 'z'], ['top-', 'top'],

        }

        if (str_starts_with($core, 'size-')) {
            return ['size', 'width', 'height'];
        }
        if (str_starts_with($core, 'w-')) {
            return ['width'];
        }
        if (str_starts_with($core, 'h-')) {

            }
            $axis = self::spaceAxis($core, $kind, $name);
            if ($axis) {
                return $axis;
            }
        }
        if (str_starts_with($core, 'bg-')) {
            return ['bg'];
        }
        if (self::isTextSize($core)) {
            return ['text-size', 'leading'];
        }
        if (str_starts_with($core, 'text-')) {
            return ['text-color'];
        }
        if (in_array($core, ['font-thin', 'font-extralight', 'font-light', 'font-normal', 'font-medium', 'font-semibold', 'font-bold', 'font-extrabold', 'font-black'], true)) {
            return ['font-weight'];
        }
        return [];
    }

    private static function hasDirectionPrefix(string $core, string $kind): bool
    {
        foreach (['x-', 'y-', 't-', 'r-', 'b-', 'l-', 's-', 'e-'] as $d) {
            if (str_starts_with($core, $kind . $d)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static function spaceAxis(string $core, string $kind, string $n): array
    {
        if (str_starts_with($core, $kind . 'x-')) {
            return ["$n-x", "$n-r", "$n-l", "$n-s", "$n-e"];
        }
        if (str_starts_with($core, $kind . 'y-')) {
            return ["$n-y", "$n-t", "$n-b"];
        }
        foreach (['t', 'r', 'b', 'l'] as $s) {
            if (str_starts_with($core, $kind . $s . '-')) {
                return ["$n-$s"];
            }
        }
        return [];
    }

    private static function isTextSize(string $core): bool
    {
        if (in_array($core, ['text-xs', 'text-sm', 'text-base', 'text-lg', 'text-xl', 'text-2xl', 'text-3xl', 'text-4xl', 'text-5xl', 'text-6xl', 'text-7xl', 'text-8xl', 'text-9xl'], true)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (str_starts_with($core, 'text-[')) {
            $rest = substr($core, 6);
            return $rest !== '' && (ctype_digit($rest[0]) || $rest[0] === '.');
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static function isNumber(string $s): bool
    {
        if (str_starts_with($s, '[')) {
            return true;
        }
        return $s !== '' && strspn($s, '0123456789.') === strlen($s);
    }

            'coalesce', 'def', 'l', 'len', 'spread', 'str', 'has', 'cnv', 'tpl', 'num', 'money', 'at', 'page_window',

        $fns['og_compose'] = [$this->rt, 'compose'];
        $fns['og_recipe'] = [$this->rt, 'recipe'];
        $fns['og_preset'] = [$this->rt, 'preset'];
        $fns['og_lucide'] = fn (mixed $name): Html => new Html($this->rt->lucide($name));
        $fns['og_include'] = fn (string $template, array $vars = []): Html => new Html($this->engine->renderToString($template, $vars));
        return $fns;
